questions.q: Which of these is a chemical change?
questions.why: Rusting forms a new substance; the others can be reversed and form no new substance.

questions.q: CuO + H₂ → Cu + H₂O. Which substance is oxidised?
questions.why: Hydrogen gains oxygen, so it is oxidised; copper(II) oxide loses oxygen and is reduced.

questions.q: Zn + Cu²⁺ → Zn²⁺ + Cu. Which statement is correct?
options: Zinc gains electrons and is reduced
Cu²⁺ ions lose electrons and are oxidised
Zinc loses electrons and is reduced
Cu²⁺ ions gain electrons and are reduced
questions.why: OIL RIG: Cu²⁺ gains 2 electrons (reduction) while zinc loses 2 electrons (oxidation).
